title: graphics
author: JG
description: add functionality to make consistent triangles with same orientation (all computed normals are outbound or inbound); used to heal imported geometries
releaseNotes: graphics.OrientTriangles orients the triangles of a TriangleList consistently and every closed part outward, merging points by position so that the triangles of STL files are connected, recomputes the normals and reports what it changed; graphics.CheckTriangleOrientation reports without changing; FromSTLfile, FromSTLfileASCII and FromPointsAndTrigs take orientTriangles=True for STL files whose orientation is not consistent.
